question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：比利时 vs 埃及（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: Belgium vs Egypt (90-minute three-way result)
one_liner_cn: 比利时实力与状态占优，但埃及全主力且防守纪律严明，平局风险不低，比利时胜率约 57%。
one_liner_en: Belgium are stronger and in better form, but a full-strength, well-drilled Egypt keeps draw risk meaningful; Belgium win at about 57%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 198 分（1894 vs 1696），中性场地下 Davidson 模型给比利时约 58% 基础胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 198-point Elo gap (1894 vs 1696) gives Belgium roughly a 58% base win probability on neutral ground under the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 比利时近五场 4 胜 1 平（5-0 突尼斯、2-0 克罗地亚），德布劳内健康并预计首发，状态明显占优。
key_reasons.en: Belgium are W4 D1 in their last five (5-0 Tunisia, 2-0 Croatia) and De Bruyne is fit and expected to start, a clear form edge.

key_reasons.cn: 埃及全主力出战（萨拉赫任队长、马尔穆什在列）且打法务实密集，利于拖平；比利时卢卡库缺乏比赛状态。
key_reasons.en: Egypt are at full strength (Salah captains, Marmoush included) with a compact pragmatic setup that favours the draw, while Belgium's Lukaku lacks match fitness.

method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net) Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) -> p_stat BEL 58.3 / Draw 23.1 / EGY 18.6; bounded evidence-based adjustment of ~3.9pp (cap 8pp) toward the draw for Egypt's full-strength defensive block and Belgium's forward-line fitness doubts -> p_final 57/25/18. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and evidence thinness. No market or odds inputs of any kind.
